query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, s.name as series_name, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where sub.name = 'Mathématiques' and lv.name = 'Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') and (l.title ilike '%dérivabilité%' or l.title ilike '%géométrie analytique%' or l.title ilike '%primitive%') order by s.name, c.title, l.title limit 20;
